feeds.title: New Jersey Monthly Magazine
feeds.description: The Garden State's premier lifestyle magazine. It's your one-stop destination for all things Jersey. This magazine has fulfilled its promise of incisive and illuminating reporting on the issues, the people, and the places that give New Jersey a unique and colorful identity of its own.

feeds.title: House of Leo
feeds.description: House of Leo is a Top New Jersey Fashion and Lifestyle Blog, which features all the latest trends, best deals and styling tips you need. House of Leo Blog is a destination for everyday style for the everyday life. Tammy is just your average girl bringing you everyday style. Style that is practical. Style that will make you feel good. Style that works for the everyday moments of your life.

feeds.title: Find Your Dazzle
feeds.description: Women's fashion and beauty blog featuring petite fashion, beauty, lifestyle, outfit ideas, how to wear, styling, and affordable fashion. Authored by Tracy Colon.

feeds.title: Jersey Fashionista
feeds.description: Jersey Fashionista is a fashion, beauty, and lifestyle blog. It covers trends, styling tips, wellness, and more. Lillie is here to inspire you, inform you, give you tips, and more.

feeds.title: Life Unsweetened
feeds.description: Life Unsweetened is a lifestyle blog created in 2012 by Rachel Ferrigno, covering topics like beauty, fashion, home, parenthood, and more.

feeds.title: Lynn Hazan
feeds.description: Lynn Hazan is a blog based in Jersey City, NJ that covers news and culture in Hudson County and beyond. Their mission is to inspire, educate, inform, and entertain our readers; from new businesses to support and local initiatives that need attention to personal stories.

feeds.title: Fit Mommy In Heels
feeds.description: Fit Mommy in Heels is the creative outlet of Lauren, a popular New Jersey Lifestyle Blogger, in which she shares styling tips, workouts and much more. Fit Mommy In Heels was created to inspire other women to be their very best selves. Whether that's helping them get into the best shape of their life, reclaim their love of fitness post-baby, or feel good about the outfits they wear.

feeds.title: The Simply Perfect Life
feeds.description: A family and lifestyle blog by Autumn Fiordland. Making every day as perfect as life allows! Sharing fashion, beauty, home, parenting, tips & tricks, gifts guides, favorite products, and more.
